verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration law firm paired with a SaaS case-management platform. A software platform of this kind could plausibly offer headless or API-driven automation, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a browser client portal, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404. Nothing documents a CLI, API, or CI/headless mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
